title: git-vouch: add 'git vouch query <did> [--at TIME]'
description: Core CLI command in git-vouch: given a did:key and optional RFC 3339 time, print the person's handle, tier and key validity at that time (retired keys valid before retirement; revoked keys never) as JSON; non-zero exit if unknown. Reuses check's tier computation. This is the only interface the bridge uses, so tier logic lives in one place.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with fixture registries: tier reported correctly; retired key valid at earlier time, invalid after; revoked key invalid at all times; unknown did exits non-zero. Oracle: fixture registries built with real ssh-keygen signatures, expected tiers stated by hand from the fixture.
notes: Implemented (uncommitted): cmd_query + tier_at in git-vouch, tests/test_query.py. Contract for faq3.4: stdout JSON {did, at, handle, tier, automation, emails, added, retired, revoked, valid}; exit 0 known, exit 1 + same JSON with handle null if unknown, exit 1 + empty stdout if registry check fails (fail closed, as export), exit 2 bad --at. Tier at TIME uses export's model (current tier or one in result.ended ending after TIME). Bridge rule: valid and emails and not automation. No [DIR] arg: queries the synced copy (or cwd before setup).
